description: HTML file containing embedded JavaScript code that demonstrates a drag-and-drop ListGrid example using the Isomorphic SmartClient framework. It defines data sets, grid configurations, and UI components for a web-based animal data viewer with drag-and-drop capabilities.

methods.name: ListGrid.create
methods.description: Creates a ListGrid component with specified data, fields, and configuration for drag-and-drop functionality.
